mode: built-in imagegen, five independent generation calls; no CLI fallback or third-party downloads

limits: Three quiet authored poses per shared body (idle, work preparation/ledger, greeting), not a hand-refined hammer-strike cycle or ten bespoke portraits. Native stock, forge, reach and collision remain. More schematic scenery, continuous gameplay review and real-phone performance validation remain.
